import socket

    data = "This is a simple test. Is it right?"
    local_socket = socket.socket().bind(("", 8080)).listen(1)
    local_socket.accept()[0].recv(1024)
    remote_socket = socket.socket()
    remote_socket.connect(("remote_server", 8081))
    remote_socket.sendall(data)
    rslt = sent_tokenize(data)
    return rslt
